ia.pregunta: Which clips do you want from this video? The AI finds the moments and you pick which ones to create.
ia.ejemplo: E.g.: one clip per webinar topic
ia.tarda: On a long video this can take up to a minute.
ia.ninguno: I didn't find moments that match. Try saying it another way.

lista.pregunta: One range per line: start, end and, if you want, the title. Without a title, the AI writes one.
lista.ejemplo:
0:05:10 - 0:06:20 How to set prices
12:40 - 13:55
1:02:30 to 1:03:40 Audience questions

errores.formato: I can't read the times. Write it like 1:02:30 - 1:03:40.
errores.alReves: the end has to come after the start.
errores.largo: a clip can be up to 3 minutes long.
errores.fuera: it starts after the end of the video.

lista.corregir: Fix the lines in red to create the clips.

demasiados: Up to {maximo} clips at a time.
creados: {n, plural, one {Done: # new clip, under your name.} other {Done: # new clips, under your name.}}
